$comment: The MAP: each element of the OpenMixer console's vintage look -> the MOD GUI element that wears it -> the pinned tokens it reads (tools/look/console-vintage.json). A token is `console:--x` (the glass, the relief, the base paint) or `finish:--x` (the metal of the look's finish, aluminium by default). `via` names the look tokens of schema/modgui-looks.json (or the SVG file) whose raw value carries each token as a {placeholder}: test/modgui-console-map.test.mjs holds every row to that, and to the pin. A row with `ownerMock: true` is the owner's reference for the vintage look and not a console element: it reads no pinned token.
